Displaced Sudanese women and children queue for food at a Save the Children community kitchen distribution site in Daba Naira camp in Tawila. Community kitchens have become an essential source of food for families in the sprawling displacement camps surrounding the town, where around 600,000 people have fled fighting in the nearby city of El Fasher and other parts of Darfur during Sudan's war.
